description_en: Re-execute all timed-out and failed device jobs under the specified device task.
description_zh: 重新执行指定设备任务下，所有已超时和失败的设备作业
name: RerunJob

parameters.description_en:
The instance ID. You can view the **ID** of your current instance on the **Instance Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.

><notice>
- If an ID exists, you must specify this **ID**; otherwise, the API call will fail.
- If the **Instance Overview** page or the **ID** is not available, this parameter is not required.

></notice>

For more information about instances, see [Instance Overview](~~356505~~).
parameters.description_zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的**实例概览**页面，查看当前实例的**ID**。

><notice>
- 若有ID值，必须传入该**ID**值，否则调用会失败。
- 若无**实例概览**页面或**ID**值，则无需传入。

></notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见[实例概述](~~356505~~)。

The device task ID. This is the globally unique identifier of the task.

You can view the task ID on the **Devices > Jobs** page in the IoT Platform console.
